hooks.command: PY=$(command -v python3 || command -v python || command -v py); if [ -n "$PY" ]; then "$PY" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"/scripts/check-workdir.py; else echo "[workdir check] WARNING: no python3/python/py interpreter found on PATH, skipping" >&2; fi

PY=$(command -v python3 || command -v python || command -v py); if [ -n "$PY" ]; then "$PY" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"/scripts/set-session-defaults.py; else echo "[session defaults] WARNING: no python3/python/py interpreter found on PATH, skipping" >&2; fi

PY=$(command -v python3 || command -v python || command -v py); if [ -n "$PY" ]; then "$PY" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"/scripts/check-workdir.py --block; else echo "[workdir check] WARNING: no python3/python/py interpreter found on PATH, skipping" >&2; fi
